summary: Quantity discount block for Buy Box displaying volume pricing in a table format.
shortDescription: The Quantity Discount Studio block displays volume-based pricing tiers in a clear table format within the Buy Box. Ideal for B2B scenarios or products with bulk purchase incentives, it shows customers exactly how much they save at each quantity level. A customizable discount flag highlights the savings, with color options including default sale styling or custom brand colors. Data can be entered manually or pulled dynamically from the commerce backend.
